description: This file defines the ItemIdKeyProvider class, which extends RecyclerView's ItemKeyProvider to supply item IDs and positions for selection handling in a RecyclerView within the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

classes.name: ItemIdKeyProvider
classes.description: Provides item IDs and positions for RecyclerView selection, mapping item IDs to view holder positions.

methods.name: ItemIdKeyProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with a RecyclerView instance.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the item ID for a given position in the RecyclerView.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Returns the position of the item with the specified ID in the RecyclerView.
